change: On a nonzero-update resume, copy the exact supplied checkpoint to the fresh output latest.pt role and retain its source/copy hash in lineage. A final-before-evaluation resume otherwise has no remaining optimizer update that would create latest.pt.
assessment: No policy, optimizer, RNG, counters, endpoint or learning-budget change. Pending final evaluation still runs and no extra optimizer update is introduced. The copied latest is explicitly the supplied boundary, not a fabricated later checkpoint.

validation.new_case: test_final_boundary_resume_preserves_latest_when_no_learning_remains verifies exact copied bytes, final-pending state and lineage hash at update1024.
validation.scope: Synthetic fixtures and read-only diff review only. No study bank, actual policy outcome, study training or cloud execution.
